text:
Mira Chen: Starting a living doc for long-term platform roadmap: routing policies, multi-region, multi-tenant isolation. Need product+eng alignment on launch criteria and priority customers.
Jordan Patel: Include cost vs latency tradeoffs; teams want predictable unit economics.
Mira Chen: Sections: customer asks, launch criteria, minimal policy set, migration path, metrics.
Alex Rivera: Need concrete cross-region failover constraints and a safe default routing that degrades gracefully.
Samir Gupta: Add compatibility matrix for model variants (quantized vs fp16) and fallback ordering.
Priya Nair: Top customer asks: region pinning, SLA-backed latency for priority tenants, isolation lanes for compliance.
Mira Chen: Proposed launch criteria: canonical policy templates (region-pin, cost-preferred, low-latency), per-tenant tail latency telemetry, rollback + automated fallback to lower-capacity variants.
Jordan Patel: Acceptance tests: synthetic latency/regression tests + 2 pilot Dedicated customers.
Alex Rivera: Ops constraints: autoscaler interactions, SLOs for burst behavior, guardrails to avoid noisy neighbors.
Samir Gupta: Define "Hard isolation" (no cross-tenant routing, no cache sharing) vs "Affinity-optimized" (best-effort affinity + shared infra). Add migration path.
Mira Chen: Isolation lanes will be called Isolated and Affinity-optimized with cost multipliers.
Priya Nair: Sales needs pricing anchors for isolation lanes; justify higher cost with audit logs, KMS, support.
Jordan Patel: Rollout playbook: internal canary, alpha, Dedicated pilot, GA. Each stage gated by observability, regressions, cost delta.
Mira Chen: Observability gates: token-level cost, per-route p99, error budgets, model-quality regressions.
Alex Rivera: Add stress tests for cross-region links and AZ failures; validate fallback latency within target.
Samir Gupta: Policy arbitration priority: tenant affinity > explicit region constraint > cost preference. Tie-breaker: latency estimates.
Priya Nair: Enterprises will require hard region isolation + storage residency; surface timeline and procurement needs.
Mira Chen: Action items: I will open PR for the living doc with default policy templates. @Jordan draft acceptance tests; @Alex and @Samir add ops constraints and fallback SLAs.
Jordan Patel: Will draft test matrix and milestones.
Alex Rivera: Will add autoscaler and stress-test reqs.
Samir Gupta: Will author model compatibility matrix and fallback sequencing.
Priya Nair: Will collect top enterprise asks and price sensitivity notes.
ProductBot: Reminder: create RFC by EOD Friday - label: roadmap/routing-isolation.
Mira Chen: Target RFC + templates by next Wed. Paste any customer examples or metrics here. :sparkles:
Jordan Patel: I'll upload pilot scripts and telemetry configs after PR.
Mira Chen: Thanks all - pinging when RFC ready for review. :rocket:
